summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a letter from Shine I FIP regarding the execution of the 1st Amendment to the New Shareholders Agreement between FIP and Petrobras. The amendment improves governance provisions related to Braskem. No specific deal terms, stake changes, or price per share were provided. The filing is a routine update on a shareholders agreement amendment, not a special-situation event like an acquisition or activist campaign. Braskem acts as the filer reporting the market development.
